name: energy_distance
title: Energy distance outputs (per-dataset bundle)
description: Outputs of the TF Perturb-seq energy-distance pipeline (`external/energy_dist_pipeline/`). For each dataset, the pipeline takes the inference MuData (post-CRISPR pipeline) and produces per-target energy distances + permutation p-values, a pairwise target-by-target distance matrix, a 2D embedding for visualization, and outlier / discordance tables. Used by Working Group 1 (transcriptome-wide significance) and Working Group 2 (TF activity clustering).
_verification_status: VERIFIED against a real run on Synapse (syn74381167 = `edist_analysis_result` for Gersbach_WTC11-benchmark_HTv2). Column names + row format confirmed for `pval_edist_full.csv`, `targeting_outlier_table.csv`, `non_targeting_outlier_table.csv`, and the four `image/*.pdf` figures. Step-3 outputs (`target_by_target_matrix.csv`, `edist_embedding_info.csv`) were NOT generated for that run, so their schemas remain sampled from `external/energy_dist_pipeline/pipeline_output/`. Optional outputs `discordance_gRNA.csv` and `annotation_file_table.csv` were not present in the Synapse run — they may be cleared / not exported by the new wrapper.

current_runner.approach: Containerized (apptainer / docker.io/takechikara/energy_distance_env:latest). Wraps the underlying `energy_dist_pipeline` bin scripts.
current_runner.input: Synapse syn ID of the inference_mudata.h5mu (i.e., the per-dataset CRISPR pipeline output). The container fetches it directly from Synapse.
current_runner.preprocess_steps: Filter genes (min_counts>=1), normalize_total, log1p, scale, PCA (n_comps=50). Builds an annotation_table.csv with `intended_target_name|chr:start-end` promoter labels.
steps: preprocess_mudata.py — pull MuData from Synapse, build PCA + gRNA dict + annotation
2_e_distance_nontargeting.py — compute energy distance per target vs. non-targeting (with permutation p-values)

earlier_runner_for_reference.note: The current containerized runner produces the same output files as this earlier non-containerized version; the schema in this document applies to both.

files.name: pval_edist_full.csv
files.description: Primary results: one row per target (gene promoter), with energy distance + permutation p-value across 20 random non-targeting backgrounds plus a `mean` summary.
verified_columns: <unnamed index column> = target identifier in format `<ENSG>|<chr>:<start>-<end>` (built by `preprocess_mudata.py` from the gRNA annotation; the chr/start/end correspond to the targeted promoter region)
cell_count = int, number of cells used for this target (capped at `target_cell_num_max`, default 2000)

type = string. Only value seen in the Synapse run is `targeting`. (Earlier non-containerized example outputs use `target` / `positive control` / `negative control`. The new wrapper labels everything that has a target as `targeting`; positive/negative controls are handled via the annotation table, not this column.)
distance_0 ... distance_19 = per-background energy distance (target vs. one randomly sampled non-targeting set). `num_of_bg=20` by default.
pval_0 ... pval_19 = per-background permutation p-value (`permute_per_bg=1000` permutations each, so resolution is 1/1000)
distance_mean, pval_mean = means across the 20 backgrounds
distance_mean_log = log10(distance_mean) (or signed transform of it)
files.verified_in_example_run: syn74381183 (Gersbach HTv2 benchmark): 64 rows × 46 cols (excl. index). cell_count uniformly 2000.

files.name: target_by_target_matrix.csv
files.description: Pairwise energy-distance matrix between all targets (square). Used by Working Group 1 for clustering and UpSet-style cross-lineage comparisons.
fields_overview: Remaining columns: one per target; cell value = energy distance

files.name: edist_embedding_info.csv
files.description: 2D embedding (UMAP/MDS) of targets based on the energy-distance matrix, with cluster labels.

files.name: targeting_outlier_table.csv
files.description: Outlier identification table for targeting guides. One row per gRNA; lower `pval_outlier` = more likely to be an outlier vs. its siblings.
files.verified_in_example_run: syn74381181 (Gersbach HTv2 benchmark): 380 rows × 1 col (excl. index).

files.name: non_targeting_outlier_table.csv
files.description: Outlier identification table for non-targeting controls. K-means on pairwise distances; outliers are non-majority cluster.
files.verified_in_example_run: syn74381180 (Gersbach HTv2 benchmark): 30 rows × 1 col (excl. index).

files.name: discordance_gRNA.csv
files.description: Per-gRNA discordance status (sibling effect agreement). NOTE: not present in the Synapse run we verified against — may be optional / not exported by the new containerized wrapper. Documented for completeness from `bin/1_filtereing_gRNA.py`.

files.name: annotation_file_table.csv
files.description: Per-gRNA annotation used as pipeline input (mirrors IGVF DACC `guide_rna_sequences` schema). Built by the wrapper's `preprocess_mudata.py`. NOT exported in the Synapse run we verified against — kept locally as input only.

files.name: config1_2.json
files.description: Run configuration for Steps 1 + 2 (filenames, gRNA-filter knobs, permutation-test knobs). Captured per-run for reproducibility.

files.name: image/
verified_files: gRNA_stat.pdf — per-target counts of dropped / outlier / retained gRNAs
e-dist_distribution.pdf — energy distance vs. p-value scatter + density
e-dist_cutoff_value.pdf — heatmap of #significant targets across (p-value, energy-distance) cutoff grids
e-dist_cutoff_value_NEG_CONTROL.pdf — same heatmap restricted to negative controls
